hero.title: Radiant Waves Media Morning Global News
hero.description: Sunday, August 23, 2026. Good morning. Here are today's leading verified global headlines, breaking developments, business, technology, climate and Africa news from around the world.

breaking: 🔴 Nigeria: At least 50 people, mostly children, died after an overloaded boat capsized in Sokoto State.
🔴 Nigeria: Families continue demanding action over children abducted nearly 100 days ago in Borno State.
🔴 Iran–US tensions continue to disrupt shipping through the Strait of Hormuz and keep global energy markets under pressure.
🔴 Ukraine: France pledges to accelerate air-defence support for Ukraine as Russian attacks and diplomatic efforts continue.
🔴 Europe: Wildfires remain a major concern, with Serbia receiving international firefighting assistance.
🔴 Sweden: Police continue investigating the deadly sword attack at a high school in Fagersta.
🔴 Global markets: Oil prices and government bond yields remain elevated as investors assess geopolitical and inflation risks.
🔴 China: Humanoid robotics continues moving from demonstrations toward practical industrial and commercial applications.

featured.title: Nigeria's Sokoto Boat Tragedy Leaves At Least 50 Dead
featured.content: At least 50 people, mostly children, died after an overloaded boat capsized in northwest Nigeria's Sokoto State. The passengers were reportedly travelling for agricultural work. Sixteen people were rescued while recovery operations continued. The tragedy has renewed concerns about boat safety, overcrowding and emergency response on Nigeria's inland waterways.

articles.title: Sokoto Boat Tragedy: At Least 50 Reported Dead
articles.description: At least 50 people, mostly children, were killed when an overloaded boat capsized in Sokoto State. Sixteen people were rescued and recovery efforts continued.

articles.title: Borno Families Demand Release Of Abducted Children
articles.description: Families in Borno State continue demanding government action nearly 100 days after children were abducted from classrooms. Reuters reports that about 45 children remain unaccounted for, while another group of students and a teacher abducted in June also remain missing.

articles.title: Nigeria's Security Challenge Remains A Major Concern
articles.description: Kidnapping, armed attacks and communal violence remain major security concerns in parts of Nigeria. Recent attacks in Plateau State have also highlighted continuing risks of violence and displacement.

articles.title: Iran–US Crisis Keeps Strait Of Hormuz In Focus
articles.description: Shipping through the Strait of Hormuz remains severely disrupted as tensions between Iran and the United States continue. Iran has granted special permission for several Iraqi oil tankers to pass, while wider maritime traffic remains far below normal levels.

articles.title: Oil Prices Remain Elevated As Hormuz Disruption Continues
articles.description: Oil markets remain highly sensitive to developments around Iran and the Strait of Hormuz. Higher energy costs are adding to concerns about inflation, fuel prices and the wider global economic outlook.

articles.title: Ukraine War Remains A Major Security Concern
articles.description: Russia and Ukraine continue military operations while European governments maintain diplomatic and military support for Kyiv. France has pledged to accelerate air-defence deliveries to Ukraine as European allies discuss additional assistance.

articles.title: France Pledges Faster Air-Defence Support For Ukraine
articles.description: French President Emmanuel Macron has pledged to accelerate military equipment and missile deliveries to Ukraine. Discussions also include support for additional air-defence systems and European coordination.

articles.title: Europe Continues Fighting Major Wildfires
articles.description: Wildfires remain a serious threat across parts of Europe. Serbia has activated international assistance as firefighters battle major blazes, while the wider region continues dealing with extreme summer weather and dangerous fire conditions.

articles.title: International Firefighting Support Arrives In Serbia
articles.description: The European Union has deployed helicopters, firefighters and emergency vehicles to Serbia through its Civil Protection Mechanism. A Russian firefighting aircraft has also been deployed as authorities battle multiple fires.

articles.title: Sweden Investigates Deadly School Sword Attack
articles.description: Swedish police are investigating the online activity of an 18-year-old former student accused of carrying out a deadly sword attack at a high school in Fagersta. One teenage girl was killed and three people were injured.

articles.title: China's Humanoid Robot Industry Moves Toward Practical Work
articles.description: Chinese robotics companies are increasingly demonstrating humanoid robots performing practical tasks such as sorting parcels, packing products and household work as the industry seeks to move beyond demonstrations toward wider commercial adoption.

articles.title: Humanoid Robot Sets New 100-Metre Record
articles.description: At the 2026 World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing, the Chinese humanoid robot Tiangong Ultra reportedly ran 100 metres in 9.39 seconds, surpassing Usain Bolt's human world record of 9.58 seconds.

articles.title: China's Robotics Ambitions Continue To Expand
articles.description: China is using robotics competitions and industrial demonstrations to showcase advances in humanoid machines, autonomous systems and practical robotic applications.

articles.title: US Debt And Bond Markets Remain In Focus
articles.description: US government debt has surpassed $40 trillion, while rising Treasury yields and fiscal concerns continue to influence global financial markets.

articles.title: Global Stocks End Difficult Week
articles.description: Global stock markets finished a difficult week as rising government bond yields, elevated oil prices and geopolitical uncertainty weighed on investor sentiment. The dollar weakened while gold gained.

articles.title: Global Investors Watch Inflation And Interest Rates
articles.description: Investors continue monitoring oil prices, inflation expectations, government borrowing costs and central-bank policy as geopolitical risks complicate the global economic outlook.

articles.title: Gaza And Middle East Diplomacy Remain In Focus
articles.description: Diplomatic efforts concerning the wider Middle East remain active as governments work to address the continuing regional conflict, humanitarian concerns and the wider impact on energy markets.

articles.title: International Security Remains A Major Global Concern
articles.description: The conflicts involving Iran, Ukraine and the wider Middle East continue shaping international diplomacy, defence policy, shipping security and global economic decisions.

articles.title: Climate And Extreme Weather Continue To Challenge Governments
articles.description: Wildfires, extreme heat and drought conditions remain major concerns across several regions. Governments are facing growing pressure to improve emergency preparedness and climate resilience.

articles.title: Today's Big Question
articles.description: When a country faces insecurity, unemployment, rising living costs and natural disasters at the same time, which should government address first — protecting lives, creating jobs, or reducing the cost of living? Tell us your opinion in the comments.

articles.title: Inspirational Quote Of The Day
articles.description: Your circumstances may explain where you are today, but they do not have to decide where you will be tomorrow.
